lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was it a T-shirt or button up shirt or what kind of shirt?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, before you just said there was a white T-shirt. She had that on too?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, and in the other interview you said it was blue. Do you remember what color it was? If you don't remember, say you don't remember.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So he threatens you and what does he say to you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That, ta help him get rid of the body.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Before you mentioned trust, that he said something about trust. Tell us about that. What did he say about that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he really likes me much and that he trusts me that I won't say nothin'.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he told me to grab her feet so I did and

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: So we took her out in the back and put her in the fire pit.
